info.text:
# Neon White

## What is this game?

[**Neon White**](https://neonwhite.rip/), developed by Angel Matrix + Ben Esposito and published by Annapurna Interactive, is an FPS speedrunning platformer described as "by freaks, for freaks." 
In this game, your goal is to defeat all the enemies and get to the end of the level as fast as possible, using gun-like cards with special abilities along the way.

## What does randomization do to this game?

The ability to fire or discard a card (including the Katana; you start with fists) is randomized individually.

Level unlocks are also randomized, grouped into missions where you must collect a set amount of Neon Ranks by default.
This can be configured to be singular Mission Unlock or Level Unlock items.

Locations are completed by collecting the gift in each level and by collecting each levels' medals, chosen by the configuration. 
By default, a check is awarded for Bronze and Ace medals.
Sidequests and gift pickups are also locations by default in this randomizer.

Beating the three boss levels (The Clocktower, The Third Temple, Absolution) is currently the only goal for this randomizer.

There are also two difficulty sliders in this randomizer to control how extreme the intended solutions are:

### Knowledge Difficulty:

- Vanilla: *Only* allow cards and strats the basegame shows you.
- Casual: Expects the bare minimum, only tricks that are taught with in-game tutorials to beat the vanilla game.
- Standard: Incorporates hidden but usually intended or otherwise easy to intuit tech/ideas. (breaking red surfaces through damage, parrying, etc.)
- Expert: Further includes some more advanced tech that is often only relevant to speedrunners. (coyote jumps, phantom boosts, conscious ammo conservation tactics, etc.)
- Master: Encompasses everything else from level-specific tech to extremely niche game quirks or nuances.

### Execution Difficulty:

- Vanilla: *Only* allow cards and strats the basegame shows you.
- Casual: Can be done by a brand-new player with minimal hassle.
- Standard: Consistently doable by a player who has all aces, especially players with dev medals.
- Expert: Doable by a player who has all dev medals and is competent with advanced tech.
- Master: Unreasonably difficult solutions that are inconsistent/overly precise to the vast majority of players.


## How can I get started?

To get started playing Neon White in Archipelago, [go to the setup guide for this game](setup_en.md)

tutorials.text:
# Neon White Setup Guide

## Requirements
- The **Steam** version of [Neon White](https://store.steampowered.com/app/1533420/Neon_White/) 
  - Xbox/Gamepass version *might* work, but will never be guaranteed.

## Mod Installation/Configuration

1. Download [MelonLoader](https://github.com/LavaGang/MelonLoader/releases/latest) and install **specifically v0.6.1** onto your `Neon White.exe`.
    - If on Linux, ensure that you set the environment variable for `WINEDLLOVERRIDES` by setting your launch arguments similar to `WINEDLLOVERRIDES="version=n,b" %command%`.
2. Run the game once. This will create required folders.
3. Download and follow the installation instructions for [NeonLite](https://github.com/Faustas156/NeonLite).
    - NeonLite is **required** for this mod.
    - **Take notice of the steps regarding the preferences manager and UniverseLib!!!!**
4. Download `NWArchipelago.dll` from the [Releases page](https://github.com/stxticOVFL/NWArchipelagoMod/releases/latest) and drop it in the `Mods` folder.
5. Additionally download `Archipelago.MultiClient.Net.dll` from the release and drop that in the *`UserLibs`* folder.
    - If you've already done this, there's usually no need to do it again.
6. Re-open the game and press **`F5`** (by default) to open the preferences menu.
7. Enable the mod in the Archipelago category and input your IP address, port, slot name, and password in Archipelago/Connection.
8. Relaunch your game one more time and enjoy!
    - Click through the preferences menu settings to configure the tracker and other settings to your liking!
    - Some settings only show up when the mod is enabled. 

## Archipelago Setup

1. Download the [Archipelago Launcher](https://github.com/ArchipelagoMW/Archipelago/releases/latest) for your preferred operating system.
2. Download the [latest APWorld](https://github.com/Badhamknibbs/ArchipelagoNeonWhite/releases/latest).
3. Launch the Archipelago Launcher and drag the .apworld file into the client. Restart the Archipelago Launcher after installing the apworld.
4. You can then generate a options configuration for yourself using one of the following two methods:
    - Press the "Options Creator" on the Launcher. Select Neon White on the left hand side of the screen that pops up and select all your preferred options. Finally, press export options and save it.
    - Press the "Generate Template Options" on the Launcher which will create .yaml's for all your installed .apworlds. Look for the 'Neon white.yaml' file, this will be the file you edit for your options.
5. Take the file that you generated in step 4 and place it in your Archipelago 'Players' folder alongside any other YAML that you will be using for your multiworld.
    - See the [below section](#what-is-a-yaml-and-why-do-i-need-one) for more explanation on this file.
6. Go back to the Archipelago Launcher and press generate. A script will run that will generate your multiworld seed and place a .zip file into your Archipelago 'output' folder.
7. You can then upload the zip to host the game as you wish. Archipelago's upload hosting page can be found [here](https://archipelago.gg/uploads).

### What is a YAML and why do I need one?
You can see the [basic multiworld setup guide](https://archipelago.gg/tutorial/Archipelago/setup/en) on the Archipelago website to learn
about why Archipelago uses YAML files and what they're for.
Please note that Neon White only allows you to type certain characters for your slot name.
These characters are: `` !#$%&'()+,-.0123456789;=@ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ[]^_`abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz{}~<>|\/``

### Where do I get a YAML?

Refer back to step 4 of the [Archipelago Setup](#archipelago-setup).

notes.text:
*Looking for the Neon White mod? Find it [here!](https://github.com/stxticOVFL/NWArchipelagoMod/releases/latest)*
*Compatible with v0.2.x of the NWArchipelago mod.*

**0.2.1: fixes a logic issue with Fuse Master/Master and Apartment Standard/Expert.** 

- ### **Card abilities can now be split across missions!**
	- Abilities can be set to either:
		- unlock **per in-game mission** (e.g. Rebirth - Elevate (Fire) to get it for every level that is in Rebirth in the base game), which is **currently the new default**, 
		- unlock per **generated mission** (e.g. Mission 1 - Elevate (Fire) to get it for every level in your *own* Mission 1), 
		- or keep them **global** (e.g. one Elevate (Fire) for the whole game).
	- You can also set certain cards to be **forced to be global** on the mission settings (e.g. it defaults to Katana and the Book of Life being 1 item each for the whole game.)
	- Additionally, some cards are now marked as *Useful* instead of *Progression* when they aren't logically relevant, and only cards that appear in those missions will appear in the item pool at all. 
- Level Randomization has been tweaked to make for better progression!
	- Levels now properly take into account all the items you would have to clear every check in that level, and influences other levels that are similar to it to be closer to it.
	- The **Level Selection Variance** setting acts very similar still, with 0% meaning it will guarantee levels in a linear order, and 100% being very random. The **default for this setting was changed** to *30%* down from *50%*.
- The **Starting Level Count** setting has been changed to go off of total check counts for your starting items. 
	- Previously, it only added starting levels that were guaranteed to be completable to your max medal, and would not select any levels that don't have gifts. 
	- This change was made to prevent restrictive starts even harder, and should make the start of the world more open. Thus, the **default for this setting was changed** to *3* down from *5*. Most settings couldn't reach 5 starting levels that fit in the criteria anyway.
- New filler items have been introduced to help any potential filler feel less repetitive.
	- Added items: Garbage, Book of Death Page, Cloud 9 Minigolf Ball, Neon Mask, Secret of Heaven.
		- All of these are referenced in voiced dialogue!
	- (Hopefully with all of these changes, you won't be seeing that much of these anyway!)

## APWorld-Only Changes
- **Universal Tracker is now** (actually) **fully supported!** (and I actually tested it this time)
	- This includes **yaml-less, glitched logic, custom location sorting that fits your mission order, and shiny new `/explain` for relevant checks!**  
- There are now **option groups** that helps keep the options in the launcher's options creator nice and categorized/sorted!
- An absurd amount of internal restructuring that makes for both less fill errors and faster fill!
	- Neon Ranks outside of the % required are classified as Useful for item filling. They're turned back to Progression in post fill (keeps UT in check and makes spoiler log generate faster).
	- A custom rule builder rule class has been made to check rules faster than before, including its own caching system which especially helps for worlds with multiple Neon Whites.
	- There is now a custom fill hook that places items inside the progression item pool in a way that speeds up gen and helps the generator get less stuck.
	- Fuzzer meta files have been added to the repo for checking progress against the fuzzer tool:
		- [`fuzzer_default`](https://github.com/Badhamknibbs/ArchipelagoNeonWhite/blob/main/worlds/neonwhite/fuzzer_default.yaml) checks against most of the default settings. (**100%!**)
		- [`fuzzer_player`](https://github.com/Badhamknibbs/ArchipelagoNeonWhite/blob/main/worlds/neonwhite/fuzzer_player.yaml) checks settings that are within reasonable ranges and probabilities for most people who play this APWorld. (**~100%!**)
		- [`fuzzer_all`](https://github.com/Badhamknibbs/ArchipelagoNeonWhite/blob/main/worlds/neonwhite/fuzzer_all.yaml) just ensures the goal condition is set to `3bosses` to help limit the amount of ignored results. (roughly **98%** success rate!)
- Various other changes were made to ensure we pass all unit tests!
	- (except for the memory leak test: there are no problems when actually generating (including no-output), but specifically the test doesn't appear to like it.)

### **Check the [game info](https://github.com/Badhamknibbs/ArchipelagoNeonWhite/blob/main/worlds/neonwhite/docs/en_Neon%20White.md) and [complete setup guide!](https://github.com/Badhamknibbs/ArchipelagoNeonWhite/blob/main/worlds/neonwhite/docs/setup_en.md)**
